blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The state weather bureau warned that heavy to intense rains may prevail over parts of Metro Manila and Luzon on Tuesday afternoon, Sept. 29, due to localized thunderstorms. In a thunderstorm advisory issued at 2:05 p.m., the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said that heavy to intense rains with lightning and strong winds may affect the following areas within the next two hours. Meanwhile, intense to torrential rains are already affecting areas listed below, and may prevail in the next two hours.
